definitions.explanation: A festival of the arts, with exhibitions, performances or both. Used for large international art festivals held across a region, such as the Setouchi Triennale ({瀬戸内国際芸術祭|せとうちこくさいげいじゅつさい}), as well as for smaller local and university events.

examples.japanese: {芸術祭|げいじゅつさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: To go to an arts festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{芸術祭|げいじゅつさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: The arts festival is being held again this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧じゅう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}かれる→置く：01092_oku⟧{芸術祭|げいじゅつさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{訪|おとず}れる→訪れる：07678_otozureru⟧。
examples.english: Many people come from abroad for the arts festival, which places works all over the island.

notes:
⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧ (art) + {祭|さい} (festival), like ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{芸術祭|げいじゅつさい}: an international arts festival
- {芸術祭|げいじゅつさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開催|かいさい}する→開催する：10441_kaisaisuru⟧: to hold an arts festival
- {芸術祭|げいじゅつさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出品|しゅっぴん}→出品：11726_shuppin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exhibit at an arts festival

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文化祭|ぶんかさい}→文化祭：05589_bunkasai⟧: a school's cultural festival, run by students, with stalls and performances
